architecture.summary: A workflow, one script message, and documents change; no runtime behavior of Thermus changes. The deploy job of hosted-image.yml names the GitHub environment production. Its deployment branch rule allows only main, so GitHub refuses a job of the environment on another branch before the job starts, and only a job of the environment can read its secret RENDER_API_KEY. The repository secret stays until the first dispatch on main passes. policy: a policy path that changes which workflow runs can reach the release key. sensitiveBehavior: it narrows the authorization of a credential that can deploy production. No container, component, edge, public module, declaration, or Mermaid view changes.
